response: Thank you for your feedback. We understand that the download notification in Firefox does not clear after the download is complete, which can be frustrating. This issue is currently open and being tracked as issue #1489673. You can follow its progress here: [Bug 1489673](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1489673). We appreciate your patience as we work on this.

Thank you for your feedback. We understand that audio and video playback issues can be frustrating. There was a reported issue (Bug #1365582) regarding playback not pausing when Firefox is closed, which has been marked as fixed. You can find more details here: [Bug 1365582](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1365582). If you're still experiencing this problem, please let us know.

Thank you for your feedback on Firefox for Android. We understand that performance can be an issue, and we want to let you know that there is an open meta bug tracking performance improvements for Firefox on Android (Issue #1400892). You can follow the progress of this issue here: [Bug 1400892](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1400892). Your input is valuable as we work to enhance the experience.

Thank you for your feedback! We understand that battery consumption can be a concern. There is an open issue regarding high battery usage in the background since beta 49, which you can track here: [Issue #1309607](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1309607). We appreciate your patience as we work on this.

Thank you for your feedback regarding the history tab in Firefox. I understand how frustrating it can be when previous tabs disappear unexpectedly. There is an open issue related to history management, which you can view here: [Issue #971922](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=971922). Your experience is valuable, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention.

Thank you for your feedback. We understand that the app is crashing when opened. There is an open issue related to crashes, specifically issue #1553506, which you can view here: [Bug 1553506](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1553506). We recommend keeping an eye on this issue for updates. Your experience is important to us, and we appreciate your patience as we work to resolve these problems.

Thank you for your feedback. I understand how frustrating it can be when the app doesn't load pages. There was a related issue, Bug #710578, which was marked as fixed in December 2011. You can find more details here: [Bug 710578](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=710578). If you're still experiencing problems, please consider reaching out for further assistance.

Thank you for your feedback! We understand that the auto upload feature is not functioning as expected on your Sony Xperia Z5. There is an open issue regarding auto upload not working for already uploaded photos, which you can track here: [Issue #6443](https://github.com/nextcloud/android/issues/6443). We appreciate your patience as we work towards a resolution.

Thank you for your feedback. I understand that you're experiencing issues with connecting to the server. There is a known issue, [#4130](https://github.com/nextcloud/android/issues/4130), related to the "could not find host" error during login, which has been marked as closed. While this indicates that the issue has been addressed, it may not have resolved all scenarios. We appreciate your patience as we continue to improve the app.

Thank you for your feedback regarding the fingerprint access feature. We understand that this has been an issue for some users. You can refer to Issue #4709, which discusses the fingerprint unlock functionality and its expected behavior. This issue was closed on November 13, 2019. You can view more details here: [Issue #4709](https://github.com/nextcloud/android/issues/4709). We appreciate your patience as we work to improve the app.

Thank you for your feedback regarding the sync function. We understand that syncing issues can be frustrating. There was a related issue (Issue #3477) regarding syncing pre-existing files, which has been closed. You can view it here: [Issue #3477](https://github.com/nextcloud/android/issues/3477). We appreciate your input and will continue to work on improving the app's performance.

Thank you for your feedback. We understand that you're experiencing crashes when backing out of a folder. This issue is similar to one we tracked (Issue #4369) regarding crashes when entering external folders, which has been marked as completed. You can view more details here: [Issue #4369](https://github.com/nextcloud/android/issues/4369). We appreciate your patience as we continue to improve the app.

Thank you for your feedback! We understand your concern regarding the auto-upload feature not uploading existing photos. We appreciate your patience as we work to improve the app.

While this issue is marked as closed, it specifically mentions problems with auto upload on Android versions below 7. We appreciate your patience and hope to improve this feature in the future!

Thank you for your feedback. We understand that you're experiencing issues with downloading subtitles in the app. This problem has been reported in issue #23633, which is currently open. You can follow the progress of this issue for updates. We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve it.

Thank you for your feedback. I understand that you're experiencing issues with subtitles in VLC. Thank you for your feedback regarding the interface and scanning speed. We understand that performance issues can be frustrating. Thank you for your feedback regarding VLC. I understand your frustration with playlist issues, particularly the duplication of entries.
